'''Borosk''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], one of a number of worlds along the frontier of [[Imperial Space]] fortified as strongpoints against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the last years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A relatively small world, its defenses included orbiting [[Ion mine/Legends|ion minefields]] and planetary [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], plus heavy planetary-defense [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] batteries. It was located near [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].

The heavily defended planet retained its military role after the peace with the New Republic, was used as a staging ground for the [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Borosk]] by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

In [[137 ABY]], the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]] out of [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], under the supervision of [[Darth Maleval]], came to Borosk to [[Battle of Borosk (137 ABY)|eliminate]] the [[908th Stormtrooper Division]], whose members had remained allied to [[Roan Fel]].<ref name="Noob" />

All of the 908th Stormtrooper legion were wiped out to the last man. Soon after the planet fell under the control of the [[Empire-in-exile]]. However, in [[138 ABY]], [[Darth Krayt]] launched an [[Battle of Borosk (138 ABY)|assault]] against the planet which was then restored to [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] rule.<ref name="War2" />
